messages:
mike_pm: Quick sync — we need to prioritize Q3 infra/product initiatives. I've got three asks: onboarding latency (customer A), Dedicated autoscale rollout, and 'cache suggestions' optimizations. Thinking RICE but worried about sequencing and dev capacity. Can folks weigh in?

anna_prod: +1 — we should bake launch criteria, not just score. customers expect <200ms p50 for onboarding flows.

jordan_eng: Is <200ms realistic without model-variant routing? Need ~2 sprints for runtime kv-cache hotpath tuning.

priya_enginfra: Dedicated autoscale needs infra work: scheduler + metrics + canary. Rough estimate: 3 engineers x 4 weeks. Blocks: router schema changes.

mike_pm: thanks. can we do a quick RICE sketch here? I'll throw rough numbers.

mike_pm: ```
Initiative | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort(days)
Onboard latency | 0.6 | 4 | 0.6 | 40
Dedicated autoscale | 0.4 | 3 | 0.7 | 60
Cache suggestions | 0.5 | 2 | 0.8 | 15
```

anna_prod: RICE math? (remember: score = (Reach*Impact*Confidence)/Effort)

mike_pm: rough scores -> onboarding ~0.036, autoscale ~0.014, cache ~0.053

jordan_eng: cache looks highest but it’s lower enterprise impact. Also sequencing: cache can be done in 1 sprint and would reduce token costs — helps product teams now.

claire_deploy: FYI Dedicated autoscale also has compliance gating — security review will add ~2 weeks.

sarah_ops: Ops prefers we keep a fast path: if cache shipped first, we can defer autoscale kickoff. Need clear owner for rollouts.

tom_research: also: measure quality regressions. caching + quantization interactions need an eval harness. That's 1 engineer ~2 weeks.

mike_pm: proposal: ship cache suggestions as quick win (sprint A), parallelize eval harness + infra prep, then autoscale in sprint B. Owner nominations?

anna_prod: I'll own the product acceptance criteria for cache suggestions.

jordan_eng: I'll do the runtime changes for cache (0.5 FTE sprint), need @priya_enginfra to expose metrics for A/B.

priya_enginfra: can do. allocate one infra engineer + schedule PR for router schema.

mike_pm: OK. Decision: cache first, then autoscale. Update the roadmap doc & RICE table. @devex_bot can you create a quick ticket set?

devex_bot: created epic RED-7812 'cache-suggestions-quickwin' and subtasks. links: https://redwood/board/RED-7812 :white_check_mark:

anna_prod: adding launch checklist: user metrics, perf SLOs, rollback criteria, customer comms.

jordan_eng: will add perf benchmark logs here: `s3://redwood-perf/cache-snapshots/1812345678`

mike_pm: thanks all. we'll reconvene EOD Friday for scope-lock. :thumbsup:
